card.name: Polite, old-fashioned speech register
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in genteel or archaic dialogue, especially right after a polite address such as "sir" or "Mr." The next word is expected to be a courteous or formal one.

modes.label: After polite address
modes.description: The comma, "sir", or the next word inside speech addressed to a person with a formal title or name.

modes.label: Formal quoted speech
modes.description: Words in quoted speech from a stern, refined or old-fashioned speaker.
modes.example: hand it over to its owner immediately<<,>> and be thankful if he takes no steps

modes.label: Genteel narration
modes.description: Words describing proper, upper-class people or manners.
modes.example: until a regret<<table>> class of people moved in.

card.writes: It pushes toward courteous, old-fashioned words like "dear", "Mr", "gentleman" and "delightful", and away from slang like "dude" and "guys".
card.plain: It marks a polite, old-fashioned way of speaking, so the model avoids casual slang.
